title: stripe-node calls hang or bypass MSW and Nock 14 mocks in tests
symptoms: Stripe requests hang until timeout when MSW is active
Requests reach the real Stripe API instead of the mock under nock 14
cause: The default Node HTTP client defers ending the request in a way that @mswjs/interceptors, which MSW and nock 14 use, did not see. 23.0.0 fixed the client.
fix: Upgrade to stripe-node 23, or switch the client to the fetch based HTTP client in tests.
apply: const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient() });
affected: stripe-node before 23.0.0 with msw or nock 14; fixed in 23.0.0, 2026-09-30
